import os,json,hashlib,subprocess,time,pathlib,tempfile,shutil
out=pathlib.Path('/Users/neon/.codex/experiments/soodles44-delivery-20260917/worker-evidence')
cache=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='soodles44-worker-cache-'))
receipt={'authorizes_landing':False,'cache_path':str(cache),'checks':{},'calls':[]}
def save():
 (out/'live-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\\n')
def call(name,env):
 start=time.monotonic(); started=time.time()
 p=subprocess.run(['./soodles','github','issue','44'],env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 token=[REDACTED_SECRET]'GH_TOKEN','').encode()
 if token and (token in p.stdout or token in p.stderr):
  raise RuntimeError('secret detected in output; raw evidence withheld')
 (out/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout)
 (out/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
 record={'name':name,'argv':['./soodles','github','issue','44'],'exit_code':p.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'started_at_unix':started}
 receipt['calls'].append(record); save()
 value=json.loads(p.stdout)
 record['observation']=value.get('observation');record['status']=value.get('status');record['next']=value.get('next');save()
 return p,value
try:
 env=dict(os.environ);env['XDG_CACHE_HOME']=str(cache);env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
 assert env.get('GH_TOKEN'), 'supervisor credential missing'
 prior=None
 for n,status in [(1,200),(2,304)]:
  p,value=call('live-cli-'+str(n),env)
  assert p.returncode==0 and value.get('status')=='read', 'live reader refused or waiting; preserve next, no retry'
  obs=value['observation']
  assert obs['authenticated'] is True and obs['status']==status, 'unexpected authenticated HTTP status; no retry'
  issue=value['issue']
  assert type(issue['number']) is int and issue['number']==44
  assert issue['url']=='https://api.github.com/repos/ed3c/soodles/issues/44'
  assert hashlib.sha256(issue['body'].encode()).hexdigest()=='4c9f5b0c5116fa62bbe993c651cdf2f01c5e2519b68b982b8785a7cabd015871'
  paths=[p for p in cache.rglob('*.json') if p.name"'!='"'budget.json']
  assert len(paths)==1
  raw=json.loads(paths[0].read_text())['body'].encode()
  assert json.loads(raw)==issue
  (out/('issue-'+str(n)+'.json')).write_bytes(raw)
  receipt['checks']['http_'+str(status)]=True
  receipt['checks']['issue_'+str(n)+'_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
  if prior is not None:
   assert raw==prior,'Issue bytes changed'
   receipt['checks']['identical_issue_bytes']=True
  prior=raw
  save()
 no_token={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k"'!='"'GH_TOKEN'}
 p,value=call('no-token-cli',no_token)
 assert p.returncode"'!=0 and value['"'status']=='refused'
 assert value['invalid']['field']=='github.credential'
 assert value['next']['owner']=='supervisor'
 receipt['checks']['no_token_correct_refusal_green']=True
 receipt['status']='passed'
except Exception as error:
 receipt['status']='blocked';receipt['failure']=str(error)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(cache)
 receipt['cleanup']={'removed_only_temporary_cache':str(cache),'cache_absent':not cache.exists(),'observed_at_unix':time.time()}
 save()
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
